What is Perfect XI?

Perfect XI is a free English top-flight draft game where you build an all-time XI from 11,077 player seasons spanning every Premier League campaign from 1992 to 2026.

Spin the wheel to land on a real Premier League club from a specific season, draft players from that squad, and build your team one position at a time. Mix modern superstars with legends from the 90s, 2000s, 2010s and beyond to create your ultimate XI.

Once your squad is complete, simulate a full 38-game season and see how far your XI can go. Matches are simulated with a Dixon-Coles model — the same statistical framework used in professional football analytics — with attack and defence ratings, home advantage and expected goals, so the results behave like real football rather than dice rolls. Can you go the season unbeaten?

Want a different challenge? Jump into World Cup 2026 mode and take a nation — or a hand-picked World XI — through a group stage and knockouts all the way to the trophy.

Eight ways to play

Every mode uses the same squad database and the same match engine. Pick the one that suits the time you have.

All-Time DraftSpin real club-seasons, take one player at a time, then simulate 38 games.
LeaguesCreate a private league, send the link, everyone plays the same draw. Best points tops the table.
Champions LeagueYour XI takes a place in the real 36 team league phase, then the knockouts.
World Cup 2026Pick a nation or build a World XI and go through the groups to the final.
DynastyOne club across decades. Ageing, transfers, contracts, the academy and the board.
All Time XIDraft from one club's entire history. Henry, Saka and Bergkamp in the same pool.
Weekly EventA new rule every week. Nobody above 85, one decade only, and others.

🏆 World Cup 2026 mode

Take on the world. World Cup mode drops your XI into a 2026-style international tournament — a group stage followed by knockout rounds, all the way to the final.

Pick one of the qualified nations and draft from its real squad, or build a World XI by drafting a star player from a different country at every position. Then play through the group, survive the knockouts and try to lift the trophy.

🌎 Pick a Nation

Choose a country and draft its real squad, then chase World Cup glory.

🌍 World XI

Draft a different nation at every position to assemble the ultimate global side.

Every match plays out live, minute by minute. Chase the Golden Boot and Golden Glove — contested against the best players from every nation — and unlock a full set of World Cup achievements in your trophy cabinet.

Popular challenges

  • Go a full 38-game season unbeaten
  • Win the league title
  • Build an All Time XI from a single club's greatest players
  • Win on Hard mode with ratings hidden
  • Draft an entire squad from the 1990s
  • Win the World Cup with a hand-picked World XI
  • Lift the World Cup without losing a single game
Frequently asked questions
Perfect XI is a free Premier League squad-drafting game. Spin the wheel to pick from real club-seasons, draft players, and simulate a full 38-game season to see how your XI performs.
All 51 clubs that have appeared in the Premier League from 1992 to 2026 are included, across 712 squad-seasons and 11,077 player seasons. Everyone from Thierry Henry to Erling Haaland.
Yes — completely free, no sign-up required. Just spin and draft.
Ratings are handcrafted estimates of each player's ability in that specific season, on a scale of roughly 60–97. Prime Mode rates every player at their career-best instead.
Your squad's average rating is converted into a strength value, then matched against 19 simulated opposition teams across 38 home and away fixtures using a Poisson goal model.
A separate mode where you draft a national-team XI — either a real qualified nation or your own World XI — and play through a group stage and knockout rounds to the final, with every match simulated live.
In World Cup mode you can build a World XI by drafting a player from a different country at each position — mixing stars from every nation into one global super-team, then taking it for the trophy.
Yes. Completed tournaments are saved under the World Cup tab in Draft History, and World Cup mode has its own set of achievements in the trophy cabinet.

Privacy Policy
⚠️ Unofficial Fan Game

Perfect XI is an independent, unofficial fan-made game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Premier League, the EFL, UEFA, FIFA, any football club, or any player featured. All club names, player names and related trademarks belong to their respective owners and are referenced for fan entertainment purposes only.

Last updated: June 2026  ·  perfectxigame@gmail.com
Who we are

Perfect XI (perfectxi.app) is a free browser-based football draft game run independently. For any privacy questions contact perfectxigame@gmail.com.

What data we collect

Google Analytics (GA4) — We use Google Analytics to understand site visits. GA4 automatically collects pages visited, time on site, device type, browser, and approximate country derived from your IP address (which is then anonymised before storage). It sets cookies _ga and _gid to distinguish returning visitors.

Local Storage — Your game progress (trophy cabinet, draft history, achievements) is saved in your browser's local storage and never leaves your device. We cannot access it. We collect no names, emails, payment information, or any directly identifying data.

Why we collect it

Analytics data is collected under Legitimate Interests (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f)) to understand how the game is used and improve it. We do not use this data for advertising and do not share it with anyone other than Google.

Third parties

The only third-party service is Google Analytics. To opt out of Google Analytics tracking across all sites, use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Your rights (UK GDPR)

You have the right to access, request erasure of, or object to processing of your analytics data. You can delete your local game data at any time by clearing your browser's local storage. To exercise these rights email perfectxigame@gmail.com. You may also complain to the ICO.

Google Analytics data is retained for 14 months before automatic deletion.

Career ModeDYNASTY
🏛 NEW · MULTI-SEASON CAREER

BUILD A
DYNASTY

One squad. Season after season. Your XI ages, grows, declines and retires — and you manage it all: the budget, the transfer market, and a board that expects results.

📈 Ages & development

Every player gets a career age. Under-24s grow each summer, players peak through their late twenties, and the decline starts after 30. At 33+ they may hang up their boots — plan for it.

💰 Transfers & budget

Your league finish earns a transfer budget each season — win the title and the board backs you with serious money. Spend it in the market on rising stars, or sell ageing legends while they still hold value.

🎯 Board expectations

The board sets a target every season based on your squad's strength. Hit it and your manager rating climbs. Miss it badly and the pressure builds…

🔥 The sack

Let your rating collapse and the board will act. A sacking ends the dynasty — your legacy is the trophies and seasons you leave behind.

THE DAILY
One draft a day, the same for everyone.
📅
The Daily

Every player in the world gets the same spins, the same formation and the same season. One attempt. Share the result as a grid that gives nothing away.

🔥
Streaks that work

Finish a season on consecutive days and your streak builds. Miss one and a free weekly shield covers you. Break it and you get one free repair a month.

⚡
Quick play multiplayer

One tap starts a live game against CPU managers with a three minute clock. The season now plays itself the moment the last squad lands.

📈
Ascension & albums

Winning the league now really does unlock the next tier, and each tier really does change the game. Your collection is split into club and season albums you can finish.
